answer:
The order is complete. The final page, `https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html`, says "Thank you for your order!" and is still open in its tab.

I logged in as `standard_user`, sorted by Price (low to high), and added the Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light. I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001, and finished the order. The cart showed both items on the cart page and the overview page.

Ordinary `click` commands often didn't register on this site. I used `eval` with a JavaScript `.click()` for the Backpack add-to-cart, the Bike Light add-to-cart, Checkout, Continue and Finish. I used `click` for the sort dropdown and the login button, and `fill` for the form fields.

**Answer:** "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
A="agent-browser --session task-bb2e27c6d6e4"; $A fill @e5 standard_user && $A fill @e6 secret_sauce && $A click @e4 && $A wait --url "**/inventory.html" && $A snapshot -i
